Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J24/J24nB138.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunmen Kuangzhen. Yunmen Wenyan owns the retained deployment: raises the teaching line that the dharma dwells in dharma-position and the marks of the world abide, and with the line still hanging asks where old Shakyamuni has gone, in a run of sutra-raisings that follows his staff turned dragon swallowing heaven-and-earth and his circle no one can exit.

Dahui Zonggao owns the retained deployment: raises Sengzhao's no-difference and Yunmen's long-is-naturally-long with the line that the dharma dwells in dharma-position and the world's marks abide, lifts the staff that this is not an abiding dharma, then carves the pupil out of the eye to see Sengzhao's no-difference and knocks the marrow out of the bone to see Yunmen's abiding dharma, throwing the staff down to watch the two places apart.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2016.xml). Record of the Mirror of the School. Yongming Yanshou owns the retained deployment: counts the line as what the three vehicles outside the gate have not yet understood, since with one mind they hate the truth of suffering and love cultivating cessation, not knowing suffering is only wisdom arising and cessation was never something cultivated, made, or done, so that one thought matching makes one thought a buddha and one day matching makes one day a buddha, with no need to die begging for three asamkhyeya kalpas.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB311.xml). Complete Record of Chan Master Juelangsheng of Tianjie. Juelang Daosheng owns the retained deployment: opening the hall for the state after the emperor's dialogue with the Fayan master, strikes his scepter of state that whoever wakes where he points finds the dharma dwelling in dharma-position and the world's marks abiding, with nothing left unequal between worldly and world-transcending dharma or between this and that, before and after, capping the patrons' hall-opening for the sovereign with the golden wheel shining out at mid-heaven and ten thousand ages singing the sage enlightened.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB466.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baishan Kai of Shanxi. Baishan Dekai owns the retained deployment: sings the line twice, first heaven not not-heaven, earth not not-earth, mountain originally mountain, water originally water, eye seeing color and nose breathing out, meet it that way and a lifetime of seeking is done, then heaven is heaven, earth is earth, mountain is mountain, water is water, meet it that way and you shoot into hell like an arrow, before granting the old worthies' handless fist and tongueless speech and adding that Longshan has people with hands make the fist and people with tongues do the scolding.

Senses.Explanation: The Lotus line that makes the world itself the abiding dharma, and the masters who raise it only to ask where the buddha went. Yunmen Wenyan raises the teaching that the dharma dwells in dharma-position and the marks of the world abide, then asks where old Shakyamuni has gone, Dahui Zonggao raises Sengzhao's no-difference and Yunmen's long-is-naturally-long with the same line, lifts his staff that this is not an abiding dharma, carves the pupil out of the eye to see Sengzhao's no-difference, knocks the marrow out of the bone to see Yunmen's abiding dharma, and throws the staff down to watch the two places apart, Yongming Yanshou counts the line as what the three vehicles outside the gate have not yet understood, hating suffering and loving cessation while not knowing suffering is only wisdom arising, and Gulin Qingmao runs it against both the Tathagata's Chan and the patriarchs' Chan, meeting it you dive seven times in and out of the red-dust heap, missing it you wait under the black mountain till the year of the donkey, asking why Shakyamuni lost his nostrils and whether anyone knows the person of the highest vehicle. Huanyou Zhengchuan, asked by the novice Tongzhao about the verse, glosses it through the five elements seen by the world's eye, gold that if its color and nature had altered since the kalpa's start would be an unabothing dharma-position and belong to the impermanent, but matched against kalpa-start gold shows not a hair's variation, so the dharma dwells in dharma-position and the marks of the world abide, Feiyin Tongrong grounds it on the actual ground, returning crane-long and duck-short, pine-straight and bramble-curved, each in its place and true to its nature, then laughs that his mounting this seat to beat two skin drums is raising waves without wind and carving sores in good flesh, the death of old Bodhidharma's wall-facing, Juelang Daosheng, opening the hall under imperial gaze, strikes his scepter of state that whoever wakes where he points finds the dharma in dharma-position and the world's marks abiding, with no worldly or world-transcending dharma left unequal, and Baishan Dekai sings both turns, heaven not not-heaven, each thing returned to itself, meet it that way and a lifetime of study is done, heaven is heaven and mountain is mountain, meet it that way and you shoot into hell like an arrow.
